oral_examination.oral_examination: 36 Residual root, pain when percussion -, pain when probing -, no loose teeth, no redness and swelling of gums, CBCT periapical low-density image 17 16 47 Maxillofacial pit and fissure caries, probe can be penetrated, pain when percussion -, pain when probing -, Black in color and hard in texture, 46 teeth are missing, the alveolar ridge is flat, and the gap between the missing teeth is narrow.

treatment_plan.definitive: 17 16 47 Recommended filling 36 Recommended extraction followed by implant restoration 46 Recommended fixed bridge restoration

source_handle: Remove all decay, reach deep dentin, but not reach the pulp exposure point, fill with ultrasonic resin, adjust the high point of the filling body, polish with 62% lidocaine block anesthesia, 4% articaine local infiltration anesthesia, gingival separation, and augmentation If the gap is tight and loose, remove it with forceps, scrape, rinse with normal saline, and apply compression to stop bleeding.
